reason: dfda5e0d adds sha2 without extending identify_algo_name_and_length (exact name match, bit-lengths for BLAKE2B/SHA3 only), so -c rejects its own tags; fix a95633e5 two days later.
0c412999 adds open_or_create_subdir where `parent_fd.mkdir_at(name, mode)?` propagates EEXIST after a NotFound stat; fix 26879cb9 retries the open.
fa24992b adds +N and /N tab stops storing Some(0) while next_tabstop tests `.is_none()`; fix 0eb2ade7 treats Some(0) as disabled.

45e6cbd1 adds linux.rs where the loop does `error = handle_error_with_force(..)` / `error = handle_unlink(..)` (old rm.rs used `error = true` and `||`); fix 2fb45c18 uses `|=`. fix_test test_rm_directory_not_writable (-rf b) gains `stderr_only(...)`, which fails at fix^ because the cleared flag makes rm try to remove `b` and print an extra 'Directory not empty'. Caveat: the exit-0 consequence in the record is overstated; the observable here is the spurious second error.

31ffc3a0 shows the mkfifo error with show!() and no `continue`, then falls through to fs::set_permissions on the existing path; fix 00f77cc7 adds `continue`. The fix's test_mkfifo_permission_unchanged_when_failed checks the existing file's mode is unchanged.

49c3386d adds PREFERRED_TZ_MAPPINGS (EDT -> America/New_York etc.) and resolves the zone offset at the input timestamp, so out-of-season abbreviations get the wrong offset; fix e4cc92ba switches to FIXED_OFFSET_ABBREVIATIONS and adds test_date_tz_abbreviation_fixed_offset_outside_season. Wrong time, not a panic.

b29d8f10 adds `let gid = uid as libc::gid_t;` in the UserOnly arm; fix 04e258f1 uses usr2gid(user) with a sync-user test (uid != gid). Commit author time is 2025-01-02 -0500, 2025-01-03 UTC: in window either way.

cdd1052c moves File::create for -o to the top of uumain, before read_input_file (the old shuf_exec created it after input was read); fix 51529dcb defers creation. Matches both listed triggers (missing input, `shuf -o file file`).

5ca995b2 replaces the len()==1 check with `*(st.first().expect("should be caught by clap"))`, but ADDRESS_RADIX has no non-empty parser, so `od -A ''` panics in release too; fix 04cd36f0 next day handles empty. 2024 intro/fix: inside the extended window. Relation true: OdOptions::new vs uu_app.

da119810 makes --dired set format = Long after Config::from already decided parse_time_style on `format == Format::Long` (previously --dired without -l was an error, so the combination was unreachable); fix ea478c2b adds `|| dired`. fix_test test_ls_dired_outputs_same_date_time_format compares `ls -l` and `ls --dired -R` row text, so it pins the time-format defect. Agree it is a separate feature from ls ACL.
